title: 6-inch flip-front drawer

scenes.label: Built around your drawer.
scenes.caption: A source-led assembly concept • E900BP

scenes.label: Every part has a purpose.
scenes.caption: Pre-installed hardware is shown in place. Green nylon connectors; metallic spring pins.

scenes.label: Align. Insert. Engage.
scenes.caption: Align all connections together before seating the frame.

scenes.label: Install the sub-front separately.
scenes.caption: Align the upper pivot pins, then seat the sub-front in its open position.
scenes.note: Separate sub-front installation; confirm pin access and fit with the shop.

scenes.label: Add the bottom support.
scenes.caption: Align the support hardware with the rear receiving locations.
scenes.note: Support fit and installation order require confirmation.

scenes.label: Slide the bottom into its grooves.
scenes.caption: The sub-front stays open on its upper pivot pins.
scenes.note: Bottom captured by the routed grooves.

scenes.label: Rotate the sub-front closed.
scenes.caption: The upper pins form the pivot; the lower pins return into the notches.
scenes.note: Keep the pins aligned. Do not force the front.

scenes.label: Connect the finished front.
scenes.caption: Insert all channel locks, pause, then slide the finished front straight down.
scenes.note: Insert together, then slide down together.

scenes.label: Ready for the next connection.
scenes.caption: Explore this drawer style with Lockdowel.

assumptions: Assembly sequence inferred from the marked PDF; no assembly-order document was supplied.
Visualization is a marketing assembly concept, not approved installation or machining instructions.
Connector outlines, receiver undercuts and engagement travel are illustrative; not production CAD.
Drawer guides, decorative pulls and cabinet carcass are intentionally outside this drawer assembly demonstration.
The 19 mm filename conflicts with the older 18 mm BOM. This concept uses 19 mm stock and preserves the 671 mm drawn overall box width; front/back width is adjusted to 633 mm.
Older bottom and support cut-list dimensions do not consistently fit the marked views; concept uses fitted groove/support dimensions.
Upper-pivot / lower-notch rotation is inferred from the drawing. Verify groove clearance, pin fit and final locking direction before using as installation instructions.

source.filename: LD 6in Flip front CL DB  with support - 19mm DOTS.pdf

description: A 6-inch drawer with a pivoting sub-front, E900BP channel locks and a center support beneath the bottom.
focus: A front that opens the assembly path.
highlights: The rear joints seat first; the sub-front installs in its own step on the upper pivot pins.
The center support sits beneath the bottom; the bottom enters from the open front.
After the sub-front rotates closed, insert the finished front, pause, and slide it straight down.
